jobs.title: CRA II/ SCRA
jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages. Our CRAs work with a manageable study portfolio, allowing them to build deep protocol and site knowledge rather than spreading their focus across too many studies. With reasonable travel expectations, accessible line management and a smaller CRO environment, experienced CRAs have the autonomy to make decisions, influence how studies are delivered and see the impact of their work. Precision for Medicine is recruiting a Clinical Research Associate II / Senior Clinical Research Associate to join our full-service team in Poland . ** This position is fully home based ** About you: You are an experienced independent monitor who takes ownership of your sites and does not wait to be told what needs attention. You understand what really matters for patient safety, data integrity and study delivery, and can distinguish critical risks from administrative noise. You build credible relationships with investigators and site teams while remaining confident in addressing difficult or sensitive issues. You identify emerging risks early, escalate appropriately and come with solutions, not just problems. You are organized and well prepared, able to manage competing priorities across your sites without compromising quality. You communicate clearly with CTMs and study teams and can confidently represent the site perspective in project discussions. You take responsibility for the quality and outcomes of your work. How we will keep you busy and support your growth: You will independently manage and monitor investigative sites, taking ownership of site performance, quality and risk identification from site initiation through close-out. This role involves treating a wide range of patient cases, from acute conditions to chronic diseases, and providing wellness advice. Issue e-prescriptions, laboratory requests, and other necessary medical documents through the platform. jobs.title: Roving Clinic Nurse
jobs.description: About the role Remedy Skintech, Inc. is seeking an experienced Roving Clinic Nurse to join our dynamic team in Metro Manila. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you will play a crucial role in providing high-quality nursing care and support to our patients in an aesthetic clinic setting. What you'll be doing Deliver high-quality laser procedures to our patients Assist on doctors' procedures In charge of post-op procedures like equipment maintenance patients' post-treatment protocols Undergo training for all Remedy treatments Collaborating with the team to coordinate patient care and facilitate a smooth patient experience Providing patient education and promoting healthy behaviours to support positive health outcomes Maintaining a clean, safe, and well-organised clinical environment What we offer At Remedy Skintech, Inc., we value our employees and strive to create a supportive, collaborative work environment. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you can expect competitive salary, and opportunities for professional development and career advancement. About us Remedy Skintech, Inc. is a leading provider of advanced dermatological services and skincare products in the Philippines. Our mission is to empower individuals to achieve their healthiest, most radiant skin through innovative treatments and personalized care. With a team of experienced medical professionals and a state-of-the-art facility, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional patient outcomes and an unparalleled customer experience. If you're passionate about nursing and committed to making a difference in the lives of our patients, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
